test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He couldn't attend the meeting ________ he was sick.
solution:
The correct answer is '**because**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The conjunction "**because**" is used to give a reason for something. 
 
• In the sentence, "**because**" explains why he couldn't attend the meeting.
